correctness.rationale: Exact evaluation gives F(a,v)=(α(a),β(a)v+γ(a)); pairwise-coprime squared field-point ideals allow arbitrary α and β independently, while vector-valued interpolation allows arbitrary γ. The three composition-idempotence equations are necessary and sufficient. A fixed active fiber has β=0 and one fixed point or β=1 and every point fixed. At each inactive base element, choosing a singleton target gives exactly 1 possible (β,γ), while choosing a whole-fiber target gives q^(d+1) possibilities. This proves all per-image/rank formulas and the sharp maximum gap for all q prime powers,d≥1; direct complete polynomial-map enumeration verified (2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(3,1), and complete affine-map enumeration verified (3,2).

value.rationale: The theorem resolves a complete natural image and image-rank classification for composition-idempotent polynomial functions on every finite split square-zero algebra, including exact preimage counts for each permissible retract set. These quantify fixed-point fiber geometry and sharp rank gaps; previous total-function and permutation enumerations do not supply the invariant. It is not a small isolated numerical special case or a renaming of the known jet normal form.
